package probe

import "os/exec"

// cmd is a package variable the closure below captures before this function
// binds it: source order and run order differ, so the binding is no command
// the check can follow.
var cmd *exec.Cmd

func closureBeforeBinding() error {
	run := func() error { return cmd.Run() }

	cmd = exec.Command("sh")
	cmd.Env = []string{"PATH=/usr/bin"}

	return run()
}
